description: P1.2 root-cure AST allowlist for strong-status data writes and publishable-surface sinks. Candidate CERTIFIED/INFEASIBLE records are untrusted data until isolated sink replay accepts their candidate_proof request; this checker remains deny-by-default so new data write points, terminal/public keys, artifact writers, or compatibility-writer references require review and source hash pinning.
pinning_note: Every allowlist source_sha256 pins the whole module file through _pin_failures, not only the listed AST node. This intentionally freezes registered data ingress and publishable sink modules until each entry is reviewed and re-pinned.
root_cure_policy: Writer identity, caller identity, closure cells, module rebinding, process-local freshness, and the compatibility wrapper are not proof authority. The allowlist records where strong-status data or publishable artifacts can be written; proof authority is the sink-side python -I replay and downstream certified-surface validators.

Generic render blueprint exporter writes caller-selected output paths through write_blueprint_payload, whose canonical optimal_blueprint.json guard rejects certified publication.
